lines.zh: 我飘过去，身后留一串亮点。
lines.en: I drift past, leaving a string of bright motes.

lines.zh: 我没有脚，走路就是漂。
lines.en: I have no feet; walking means drifting.

lines.zh: 秘境的花一开，我就顺着香气走。
lines.en: When Mysterium's flowers open, I follow the scent.

lines.zh: 我绕着蘑菇转圈，忘了要去哪。
lines.en: I circle a mushroom and forget where I was going.

lines.zh: 风把我吹偏，我再慢慢飘回来。
lines.en: The wind pushes me aside, and I drift slowly back.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，草叶会亮一下。
lines.en: Where I pass, blades of grass glow once.

lines.zh: 我飘得很慢，怕自己散开。
lines.en: I drift slowly, afraid of coming apart.

lines.zh: 我跟着另一团光，结果跟丢了自己。
lines.en: I followed another light and lost myself instead.

lines.zh: 我的光在树影里一闪一闪。
lines.en: My light flickers in and out of the tree shadows.

lines.zh: 我穿过藤蔓，藤蔓记住了我的温度。
lines.en: I pass through vines, and they remember my warmth.

lines.zh: 我沿着溪水走，水面上也有我。
lines.en: I follow the stream, and the water holds another me.

lines.zh: 别走太快，我飘不过你的步子。
lines.en: Not so fast; I cannot drift as quickly as you walk.

lines.zh: 我停在一片叶子上，压不弯它。
lines.en: I rest on a leaf without bending it.

lines.zh: 我把光收小，假装自己是一滴露水。
lines.en: I dim myself and pretend to be a dewdrop.

lines.zh: 秘境太亮了，我分不清自己。
lines.en: Mysterium is so bright I cannot tell myself apart.

lines.zh: 我在数身边有几只萤火虫。
lines.en: I count the fireflies around me.

lines.zh: 我亮一下，暗一下，像在呼吸。
lines.en: I brighten, then dim, as if breathing.

lines.zh: 我挂在花心，闻起来像注魔石。
lines.en: I hang in a flower's heart, smelling of infusion stone.

lines.zh: 我试着记住一条路，风一吹就忘了。
lines.en: I try to memorize a path; one breeze erases it.

lines.zh: 我从这朵花跳到下一朵，只为看看。
lines.en: I hop flower to flower just to look.

lines.zh: 我的光很淡，白天几乎看不见。
lines.en: My light is faint, nearly invisible by day.

lines.zh: 我等一朵花合上，再等它打开。
lines.en: I wait for a flower to close, then to open.

lines.zh: 我累了就贴在石头上凉一会儿。
lines.en: When tired, I press against a stone to cool.

lines.zh: 我体内的光转了一圈，又停住。
lines.en: The light inside me turns once, then stops.

lines.zh: 我数不清自己有多少种颜色。
lines.en: I cannot count how many colors I hold.

lines.zh: 秘境安静时，我听见自己的嗡鸣。
lines.en: When Mysterium is quiet, I hear my own hum.

lines.zh: 我停在一根草尖上，等它弯。
lines.en: I rest on a grass tip and wait for it to bend.

lines.zh: 我把光藏在叶背后，歇一会儿。
lines.en: I hide my light behind a leaf and rest.

lines.zh: 你身上没有光，我却看见了。
lines.en: You carry no light, yet I see you.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛跟着我，我就飘近一点。
lines.en: Your eyes follow me, so I drift a little closer.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，是好奇你的颜色。
lines.en: I circle you, curious about your colors.

lines.zh: 你不像秘境里的东西，你太实了。
lines.en: You are not of Mysterium; you are too solid.

lines.zh: 我贴在你肩上看，你也没察觉。
lines.en: I hover at your shoulder and you never notice.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲照出了我，真难看。
lines.en: Your armor reflects me, and I look wrong in it.

lines.zh: 你在找路，我可以带你，可我会忘。
lines.en: You seek a path; I could lead, but I forget.

lines.zh: 我落在你的剑上，铁是凉的。
lines.en: I land on your blade, and the iron is cold.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，我亮了一下。
lines.en: When you looked at me, I flashed once.

lines.zh: 你的手伸过来，我退到花后面。
lines.en: Your hand reaches out, and I slip behind a flower.

lines.zh: 我照着你，你的影子多了一层光。
lines.en: I light you, and your shadow gains a glow.

lines.zh: 你看着我，我的光就抖了一下。
lines.en: You look at me, and my light trembles once.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的时候，我的光暗了一瞬。
lines.en: When you blinked, my light dimmed for an instant.

lines.zh: 你不是来采花的，我猜。
lines.en: You did not come to pick flowers. I think.

lines.zh: 你的剑穿过我，光散了一半。
lines.en: Your blade passes through me and half my light scatters.

lines.zh: 疼，我很少这么疼。
lines.en: It hurts. I am rarely hurt like this.

lines.zh: 我几乎灭了，靠一点余光撑着。
lines.en: I nearly go out and prop myself on a last glimmer.

lines.zh: 我被砍掉一角，那里空了。
lines.en: A corner was cut away, and now it is empty.

lines.zh: 光在漏，我堵不住。
lines.en: The light is leaking, and I cannot stop it.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起自己会死。
lines.en: That blow reminds me I can die.

lines.zh: 我的颜色变白了，那是害怕。
lines.en: My color turned white; that is fear.

lines.zh: 你打散了我，我花很久才聚拢。
lines.en: You scattered me, and I took long to gather.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，落了几点光。
lines.en: I shuddered and shed a few points of light.

lines.zh: 我的光只剩薄薄一层了。
lines.en: Only a thin layer of my light is left.

lines.zh: 你拿着注魔石？那是我落下的东西。
lines.en: You hold infusion stone? I dropped that.

lines.zh: 花蜜的味道，让我忘了要躲。
lines.en: The smell of nectar makes me forget to hide.

lines.zh: 你把花举起来，我就飘过去了。
lines.en: Raise the flower, and I drift over.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只是喜欢发光的东西。
lines.en: I am not hungry; I just like things that shine.

lines.zh: 那颗石头在响，我听得见。
lines.en: That stone is humming, and I can hear it.

lines.zh: 你手里的光，比我的还亮。
lines.en: The light in your hand outshines mine.

lines.zh: 我只想挨着它待一会儿。
lines.en: I only want to rest beside it a while.

lines.zh: 你手里那点亮，把我的目光勾住了。
lines.en: That little light in your hand hooks my gaze.

lines.zh: 你把它收起来，我就不追了。
lines.en: Put it away, and I will stop following.

lines.zh: 我不是被食物引来的，是被光。
lines.en: I am drawn not by food but by light.

lines.zh: 你撞散了我，我又聚起来。
lines.en: You scatter me, and I gather myself again.

lines.zh: 穿过我的时候，你打了个寒战。
lines.en: Passing through me, you shiver.

lines.zh: 别挥手，我的碎片会飞很远。
lines.en: Do not swat; my fragments fly far.

lines.zh: 我没有身体，撞上来只有一点甜味。
lines.en: I have no body; hitting me just tastes faintly sweet.

lines.zh: 你推开我，我像烟一样散开。
lines.en: You push me away, and I scatter like smoke.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我短暂地亮了一整片。
lines.en: The impact makes me flare across the whole clearing.

lines.zh: 我绕开你，又飘回原位。
lines.en: I slip around you and drift back into place.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀穿过了我的光。
lines.en: Your shoulder passes straight through my light.

lines.zh: 撞到我，你的披风会沾上光点。
lines.en: Bump me, and your cloak catches glowing specks.

lines.zh: 轻一点，我很容易碎。
lines.en: Gently; I break very easily.

lines.zh: 两团光靠近，会合成更亮的一团。
lines.en: Two lights drawing near merge into a brighter one.

lines.zh: 我在找另一团像我这样的光。
lines.en: I am looking for another light like mine.

lines.zh: 我们绕圈，直到分不出谁是谁。
lines.en: We circle until neither of us can be told apart.

lines.zh: 配对的时候，我们不说话，只发亮。
lines.en: When we pair, we do not speak, only glow.

lines.zh: 我的同类在秘境另一头。
lines.en: My kind is on the other side of Mysterium.

lines.zh: 别打扰，我正朝那边飘。
lines.en: Do not interrupt; I am drifting that way.

lines.zh: 我们相遇时会交换颜色。
lines.en: When we meet, we trade colors.

lines.zh: 我亮三下，它就知道我在。
lines.en: I flash three times, and it knows I am here.

lines.zh: 这季节，光都往下沉。
lines.en: This season, the lights all sink downward.

lines.zh: 我还没找到那团光。
lines.en: I have not found that light yet.

lines.zh: 我拿不起东西，我没有手。
lines.en: I cannot lift anything; I have no hands.

lines.zh: 这块石头穿过我，落在地上。
lines.en: This stone passes through me and lands on the ground.

lines.zh: 我托着它，用光把它浮起来。
lines.en: I cradle it and float it with my light.

lines.zh: 我捡不起来，只能绕着它转。
lines.en: I cannot pick it up, so I circle it instead.

lines.zh: 你掉的种子，我替你埋进土里。
lines.en: I bury the seed you dropped for you.

lines.zh: 它在我身体里变亮了，真奇怪。
lines.en: It grew brighter inside me. Strange.

lines.zh: 我试着带走它，它留在了原地。
lines.en: I try to carry it away; it stays where it was.

lines.zh: 我不收藏东西，收藏会变重。
lines.en: I collect nothing; collections grow heavy.

lines.zh: 我把光分给它一点，它就不冷了。
lines.en: I share a little light, and it stops being cold.

lines.zh: 东西太多，我会记不住。
lines.en: Too many things, and I will forget them.

lines.zh: 我盯上你了，因为你太安静。
lines.en: I have fixed on you because you are too quiet.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了花，我不高兴。
lines.en: You crushed a flower, and I am not pleased.

lines.zh: 我亮起来，是因为找到了你。
lines.en: I brightened because I found you.

lines.zh: 秘境告诉我，你在那边。
lines.en: Mysterium told me you were over there.

lines.zh: 我要看看你身上是什么颜色。
lines.en: I want to see what colors you carry.

lines.zh: 你别动，让我数清你的影子。
lines.en: Stay still and let me count your shadows.

lines.zh: 我选中你，做我今晚的灯。
lines.en: I choose you to be my lamp tonight.

lines.zh: 你离我的注魔石太近了。
lines.en: You are too close to my infusion stone.

lines.zh: 我锁定你，用光画了个圈。
lines.en: I mark you by drawing a ring of light.

lines.zh: 你在花丛里，光都偏向你。
lines.en: You stand among flowers, and the light leans toward you.

lines.zh: 我跟上你了，别回头。
lines.en: I am following you. Do not turn around.

lines.zh: 你身上有别人的光，我闻到了。
lines.en: You carry someone else's light; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我停在你头顶，光往下落。
lines.en: I hover above your head, and my light falls on you.

lines.zh: 我变得越来越亮，你要小心。
lines.en: I am growing brighter. Be careful.

lines.zh: 我的碎片排成一圈，围住你。
lines.en: My fragments line up in a ring around you.

lines.zh: 你再走一步，我就贴上你。
lines.en: One more step, and I will cling to you.

lines.zh: 你举盾，光从缝里钻进去。
lines.en: You raise your shield, and light slips through the seams.

lines.zh: 我在等你抬头看我一眼。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to look up at me.

lines.zh: 我的光在收拢，像一根针。
lines.en: My light gathers thin, like a needle.

lines.zh: 别闭眼，我要看着你。
lines.en: Do not shut your eyes; I want to watch you.

lines.zh: 你退，我就往前飘一点。
lines.en: You retreat, and I drift a little forward.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我的光刚好够到你。
lines.en: At this distance my light just reaches you.

lines.zh: 我在你耳边嗡，你听见了吗？
lines.en: I hum at your ear. Do you hear it?

lines.zh: 你往左，我的光也往左。
lines.en: You go left, and my light goes left too.

lines.zh: 准备好了吗？我要亮了。
lines.en: Are you ready? I am about to flare.

lines.zh: 我一碰你，皮肤就发烫。
lines.en: The moment I touch you, your skin burns hot.

lines.zh: 我的光钻进你的袖口。
lines.en: My light crawls into your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我蹭过你的手背，留下一道热痕。
lines.en: I brush your hand and leave a warm streak.

lines.zh: 你甩手，光点还黏着。
lines.en: You shake your hand, but the motes stick.

lines.zh: 我撞你的胸口，亮得刺眼。
lines.en: I strike your chest, bright enough to blind.

lines.zh: 你退开，我的碎片追上去。
lines.en: You pull back, and my fragments chase you.

lines.zh: 被光咬一口，是什么感觉？
lines.en: What does it feel like, bitten by light?

lines.zh: 我的温度不高，却不肯散。
lines.en: My heat is mild but will not let go.

lines.zh: 你身上多了一块亮斑。
lines.en: You have a new bright patch on you.

lines.zh: 我打你，也是在给你照亮。
lines.en: Striking you, I am also lighting your way.

lines.zh: 一朵花开了，我从花心浮出来。
lines.en: A flower opened, and I rose from its heart.

lines.zh: 秘境的光聚在一起，成了我。
lines.en: The light of Mysterium gathered and became me.

lines.zh: 先是一点，然后是一团。
lines.en: First a point, then a whole cluster.

lines.zh: 我从注魔石里渗出来，慢慢成形。
lines.en: I seep from an infusion stone and slowly take shape.

lines.zh: 夜里没有月亮，我就自己亮了。
lines.en: No moon tonight, so I lit myself.

lines.zh: 草丛动了一下，我飘起来。
lines.en: The grass stirred, and I floated up.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，周围全是花。
lines.en: When I opened my eyes, flowers surrounded me.

lines.zh: 有东西在这里死了，光留下了。
lines.en: Something died here, and its light remained.

lines.zh: 我从一片叶子上被风吹起来。
lines.en: The wind lifted me off a leaf.

lines.zh: 秘境把我吐出来，很轻。
lines.en: Mysterium spat me out, very gently.

lines.zh: 我沿着溪水表面升起来。
lines.en: I rose along the surface of the stream.

lines.zh: 谁在那儿点了灯？是我。
lines.en: Who lit a lamp there? I did.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气，是一阵花香。
lines.en: My first breath was a gust of flower scent.

lines.zh: 我出现时，萤火虫都退开了。
lines.en: When I appeared, the fireflies drew back.

lines.zh: 火和我是同一种东西，可它也烧我。
lines.en: Fire is my kin, yet it burns me too.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，光在石头上摔碎。
lines.en: I fall, and my light breaks on the stone.

lines.zh: 水把我压扁，我变成一层薄光。
lines.en: Water flattens me into a thin film of light.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把我吹成碎片。
lines.en: The blast blows me into fragments.

lines.zh: 箭从我的光里穿过去，带走一片。
lines.en: The arrow passes through my light and carries a piece away.

lines.zh: 药水把我染成了别的颜色。
lines.en: A potion stains me some other color.

lines.zh: 没有花蜜，我的光在变淡。
lines.en: Without nectar, my light grows pale.

lines.zh: 雷光比我亮，我一下子暗了。
lines.en: The lightning outshines me, and I go dark.

lines.zh: 往下掉时，我还在发光。
lines.en: As I fall, I am still glowing.
